theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

derived_geometry.source_geometry: finite sampled annulus in scene emitter; exact inner radius for V2, thin-wall inferred inner radius for V0

theory.equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V2 exact annulus: ri^2=ro^2-M/(rhoCase*pi*L); t=(ro^2-ri^2)/(ro+ri); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)); emitted mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
theory.states: One immutable scene field with stable source ordinals, age/continuation and per-victim crossing history; point position/velocity; no segment or connected-expansion state.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.
theory.limits: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: aim-120c: W=20kg,C=7.17kg,M=10.9055kg,D=0.16002m,L=0.313215656m,t=0.00937169949m,N=1688,v=1828.90539m/s; Only selected finite V2 AAM source and turning-CPA/station fuze. Explicit finite geometry differs from retained V0 cousins; no C7 hardware internal reconstruction is inferred.

primary_sources.title: R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405, The Initial Velocities of Fragments from Bombs, Shell, Grenades (1943)
primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V2 exact annulus: ri^2=ro^2-M/(rhoCase*pi*L); t=(ro^2-ri^2)/(ro+ri); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)); emitted mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.

fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

The card explicitly reuses C7 warhead information because exact D data are unpublished. fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

primary_sources.title: R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405, The Initial Velocities of Fragments from Bombs, Shell, Grenades (1943)
primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

primary_sources.title: R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405, The Initial Velocities of Fragments from Bombs, Shell, Grenades (1943)
primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: aim-9m: thermal_conscan_reticle.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0007917304360898403, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6, receiver_reticle_periods=12, receiver_reticle_frequency_hz=132.62911924324612, receiver_reticle_scan_radius_rad=0.024, receiver_reticle_stop_radius_rad=0.048. Reticle receive law is newly selected; WDU17/B label does not establish the single-detector/spoke hardware. Historical passive-fin assertion abort was a fixture failure, not a warhead result.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

primary_sources.title: R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405, The Initial Velocities of Fragments from Bombs, Shell, Grenades (1943)
primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Finite imaging pixels/PSF, charge noise/ADC, background contrast and segmentation followed by measured feature association.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: asraam: thermal_image.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0013526519869112555, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6. Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.states: One immutable scene field with stable source ordinals, age/continuation and per-victim crossing history; point position/velocity; no segment or connected-expansion state.

primary_sources.title: R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405, The Initial Velocities of Fragments from Bombs, Shell, Grenades (1943)
primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
theory.states: One immutable scene field with stable source ordinals, age/continuation and per-victim crossing history; point position/velocity; no segment or connected-expansion state.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.

primary_sources.title: R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405, The Initial Velocities of Fragments from Bombs, Shell, Grenades (1943)
primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Magic2 frontal detection and a historical multi-element description are not evidence for this scalar reticle. Pre-fragmented wording is represented by equivalent point fragments, not an authored preform map.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes

fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C), H=M+C/2; dln(v_uncapped)/dln(W)=-(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(C)=(1-s)*W/(2H), dln(v_uncapped)/dln(G)=1; diameter has no direct Gurney-speed derivative.
These derivatives vary authored total/charge with their case-mass linkage; the original independent-M/C derivatives are a different, still valid partial derivative.
Inside the strictly active1400m/s rod cap, actual-speed derivatives vanish but mass, kinetic energy, area, blast proxy and geometry can still respond.

For fixed integer N, point/discrete parallel-velocity source energy=M*v^2/2; connected source energy multiplies (2+cos(2*pi/N))/3. Count boundaries require finite branch evaluation, not a derivative of round().

V0 L proportional to D^-2 and t proportional to D within L>.001; point raw count changes with D^-3, whereas discrete-rod raw count is diameter-invariant in this algebraic branch. Integer count and finite chord/area still require exact evaluation.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

primary_sources.locator: Original report, equations(2.1),(2.3),(2.4), pp4-5; public-release original reproduced by archive
primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

emission_equations: Nonconnected emitter consumes axial=L*(U1-1/2), phi=2*pi*U2, radius=sqrt(ri^2+U3*(ro^2-ri^2)). For POINT elements only, source offset=axial*nose+radius*radial(phi): uniform cylindrical material volume, not uniform radius.

Select a zone with its normalized mixture share and draw cos(theta) uniformly between cos(to) and cos(from). Ejection uses the SAME phi as source position; their azimuths are correlated. V0 point and discrete-rod zones differ; overlapping authored bands are mixture contributions.

Scene emitted mass per element=M/N. Point velocity=burstVelocity+spin cross offset+sourceSpeed*direction. DISCRETE ROD endpoints overwrite the point proposal: at=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)-nose*L/2 and end=burstAt+radius*radial(phi)+nose*L/2. Their midpoint has no random axial offset; the earlier axial RNG draw remains consumed. Endpoint velocities use their own spin lever arms. Discrete rods carry no connected expansion state.

Connected rings use shared adjacent polygon positions and velocities, expansionPerS=v/ro, Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), breakupAge=(Rmax-ro)/v, materialLength=2*Rmax*sin(pi/N). N is an equivalent resolution, not measured weld count.

Legacy synchronous ZonedCaseWarheadV1::assess delegates to damage::assess with its retained point-source/nominal-fragment conventions except connected-ring selection. World production emitScene uses the finite immutable scene population above. Do not transfer one entrypoint geometry/mass convention to the other.
native_domains: Selected card requires finite W>C>0, G>0 and positive diameter. V0 uses s=.15, diameterRatio=.9, case/charge/structure densities7850/1700/2780kg/m3, fragmentCd1.3 and a rod-speed cap1400m/s as explicit software assumptions.

V2 requires matching explicit source/model version, positive finite densities/Cd/TNT input,0<=s<1,0<diameterRatio<=1, positive annular inner-radius squared and an authored source envelope inside body length/diameter.

Equivalent nominal mass/area/length must be finite and positive. Construction rounds positive count; the scene emitter requires1<=N<=1000000. Connected rings additionally require rod kind,N>=3 and N*L/(2*pi)>outer radius.

Zones require finite0<=from<=to<=180degrees, nonnegative shares and positive finite total. Burst position/velocity/axis/spin must be finite and axis nonzero. Emitter RNG commits only after successful complete emission.
Rounding, rod cap and inner-radius floor create piecewise domains. Smooth sensitivities below apply only within the indicated branch; the finite +/-1% examples report count/branch changes explicitly.
